arguments.evidenceClass: source/lifecycle argument; no reconstruction of every crash
arguments.badHistory: Accepted callback or error survives its receiver; unknown join is used as either safe reuse or a VM-wide GC veto
arguments.rule: Outcome and native-user custody outlive execution admission; detach heap participation only with an immutable no-RUN empty-domain certificate; native reuse still requires known closure
arguments.premise: Complete legal senders, callback tails and OS-result inventory; a recoverable failure has an independent progress agent
arguments.refutation: A published actor still writes the heap, or a retained handler has no disposition; empty-startup isolation does not cover either
arguments.present: Scoped unpublished-actor isolation implemented; complete result/mailbox and exit lifecycle replacement open
arguments.gain: Three healthy participants complete three GCs while one unpublished actor is retained; general progress gain is conditional
arguments.cost: Native handle and descriptor retention, admission/drain synchronization, bounded-capacity policy
arguments.next: Close all accepted outcomes and final native users before generalizing beyond empty unpublished actors
arguments.retirement: Remove implicit live-catcher assumption only after every legal sender and unwind path has a disposition

arguments.evidenceClass: current separated storage and conditional work-closure design
arguments.badHistory: A participant leaves while private frontier, Tail, weak-phase or release work can still create descendants
arguments.rule: ExecutionContext, GCParticipant and CollectorWorkContext have separate lifetimes; completion requires closed producers plus zero private, queued, running and descendant debt
arguments.premise: Every producer and last use mapped; publication orders payload visibility before consumer authority; scheduler fairness is separate
arguments.refutation: finish reopens work after close, or an exiting worker has the only unrecorded cursor; an empty queue is insufficient
arguments.present: VM-owned role arrays and explicit chunk transport implemented; synchronous carriers remain; independent workers and full phase closure open
arguments.gain: Remove implicit PSTATE lifetime as collector-work lifetime; permit worker policy to change without changing Scheme execution identity
arguments.cost: Descriptors, counters, cache traffic and publication synchronization; no parallel speedup established
arguments.next: Prove producer closure and the root-cut/capacity handoff before enabling independently scheduled workers
arguments.retirement: Replace collector PSTATE aliases only after all roots, phase producers, resize paths and consumers are mapped

arguments.evidenceClass: native duplicate ordinary-scan request witnessed; universal producer/crash explanation open
arguments.badHistory: Two delivered traversal requests repair the same destination fields, while forwarding visibility is mistaken for completed payload and Tail ownership
arguments.rule: Transport delivery is distinct from object write authority; one canonical initializer, one ordinary scanner and separately owned Tail/frame-link work; reserve a real contiguous interval before forwarding
arguments.premise: All pair/frame/weak adapters obey the same claim and publication protocol; closed source bound, maximum request and injective physical layout precede parity flip
arguments.refutation: Any bypass performs field repair without the claim; per-copy refunds are used as a whole-round capacity proof; raw-ready frame exposes an unfinished semantic link
arguments.present: Object authority, unified FIFO, frame domain and private copy grants implemented; full pre-flip planner unimplemented
arguments.gain: At most one ordinary field-repair execution per destination despite duplicate delivery; no claim that delivery count or total runtime drops by the same amount
arguments.cost: Packed scan metadata 1.5625 percent of section payload; resets, lookups/CAS and frame-gate serialization
arguments.next: Bind frozen root and source identity to actual whole-round interval grants and restoration reserve
arguments.retirement: Retire implicit local-state recovery only after exact progress, publication, rejection and unknown-outcome adapters qualify

arguments.evidenceClass: actual request transport replaced; full raw FFI writer coverage open
arguments.badHistory: Movable thunk lives only in a copied sync operation across another request's GC; nested entry allocates before incoming root registration
arguments.rule: Register VM-owned root before publishing stable origin/serial; consumers reload after GC; ACK only after consumption and transport drain; generated native activation plans protect pre-marker inputs
arguments.premise: Every GC-capable conversion, nested callback, exceptional exit and raw borrower is covered or explicitly excluded; no stale C local is treated as a root
arguments.refutation: A new conversion allocates before the root plan or an exceptional ACK removes a still-readable source; fixed slot count does not bound retained graph bytes
arguments.present: Fixed request cells, stable sync tokens, GC reload and retained failure roots implemented; general generated RootHandle/FFI replacement open
arguments.gain: Eliminate movable payload from resize transport; one pending root per bounded origin is scanned even outside active membership
arguments.cost: 1536 additional VM bytes against its immediate predecessor; at most 64 request-cell visits per GC; retained payload graph can exceed that fixed storage
arguments.next: Complete pre-marker root protection and all native borrower/exit adapters before retiring handwritten entry choreography
arguments.retirement: Retire handwritten per-entry root choreography only after complete caller and exceptional-exit coverage

arguments.evidenceClass: source-effect inventory and target design; complete deferred-release service not implemented
arguments.badHistory: Collector waits for a foreign destructor's owner callback while that owner is parked waiting for collector completion
arguments.rule: Release effects and owner affinity are declared; eligible rooted work is accepted before GC resume and drained with descendant accounting after required owners can run
arguments.premise: All release producers, native payload dependencies, budgets and failure dispositions covered; ineligible callbacks keep a supported explicit route
arguments.refutation: Deferred task still borrows reclaimed PSTATE or requires a callback prohibited by its wait; moving work into a queue alone removes no cycle
arguments.present: Research contracts; complete runtime service and C refinement open
arguments.gain: Remove eligible external blocking effects from GC critical completion; total destructor work is preserved
arguments.cost: Queueing, rooted retained bytes, affinity dispatch, descendant counters and shutdown drain
arguments.next: Classify every actual release-function constructor and close payload custody before replacing inline cleanup
arguments.retirement: Retire inline cleanup only for declared resource classes after payload roots, task acceptance and final drain close

arguments.evidenceClass: generated frame contracts and native multi-shot witness; universal generated-consumer refinement open
arguments.badHistory: Scanner and continuation restore interpret the same frame/link slot under different coordinates or treat raw copy completion as legal resumption
arguments.rule: Scheme owns FrameSpec and PointId; generated descriptors serve stack-to-heap mapping, ordinary roots, structural links, tail dispatch and resumption; each multi-shot restore gets a fresh execution view
arguments.premise: Every frame kind, dynamic rest/apply, floating materialization, serializer and native return consumer shares the schema; C activation origin remains valid
arguments.refutation: One-shot is substituted for multi-shot, or a restored dynamic-wind extent is reused as a current native resource permit
arguments.present: Frame decoding and ordinary/link access split implemented; complete semantic schema and all consumers not yet retired
arguments.gain: One frame meaning across control and GC; enables certified mature-continuation minor-scan skipping only with complete writer/barrier coverage
arguments.cost: Metadata, spill/reload, restore work, write barriers and remembered roots; current frame gate can serialize work
arguments.next: Use repeated map-continuation restoration as a cross-consumer oracle; study Chez and Guile for segment, prompt and composition contracts; close all frame kinds and native origins
arguments.retirement: Retire duplicate frame decisions after every generator/runtime consumer shares schema and preserves supported continuations

arguments.evidenceClass: effective-profile and exact completed-bootstrap reuse observations
arguments.badHistory: Compiler or runtime ABI changes but a stale header/archive is reused; make parallelism is mistaken for same-VM SMP population
arguments.rule: Typed effective capability and ABI identity bind every generated/native artifact and runtime witness; one shared scheduling budget controls independent actions
arguments.premise: Full actual tool/options/input identity and complete product inventory; dynamic build dependencies either controlled or rejected
arguments.refutation: A real compiler/header/environment input is absent from the key, or hash validation costs exceed eligible avoided work
arguments.present: Existing Bazel profile used; exact 2505-entry product lease reused for two independent wide-root lanes; complete new build architecture open
arguments.gain: This verification reruns no bootstrap: only two fixture compilations and executions; no general cold-build speedup follows
arguments.cost: Identity validation, artifact inventory, dependency recording and budget arbitration
arguments.next: Qualify no-op, leaf and macro invalidation against clean builds under identical semantics and toolchain lineage
arguments.retirement: Retire string-only capability inference after configured-header, object, link and runtime witness coverage

arguments.evidenceClass: source ownership and target semantic/native contract
arguments.badHistory: C macro emission and runtime layout independently reconstruct semantic decisions; unchanged output unnecessarily invalidates downstream native work
arguments.rule: Scheme produces completed FrameSpec/ModuleSpec/effect/allocation plans once; modern generated C mechanically realizes them; LLVM/MLIR consumes the same semantics through a separate backend boundary
arguments.premise: Generated declarations and runtime/link consumers migrate together; external semantic effects are part of dependency closure
arguments.refutation: A second policy remains in C or MLIR, or a Zig/LLVM wrapper is added while all old emitters and interpretation paths remain authoritative
arguments.present: Modern C is required; partial frame consumer migration implemented; complete plan producer, modular C ABI and alternate backend open
arguments.gain: Leverage Gambit semantic knowledge across native consumers; eligible identical output cuts off downstream work; backend choice no longer owns Scheme semantics
arguments.cost: Schema/generator verification, ABI invalidation, descriptors and backend-specific lowering; Zig has no automatic incremental benefit
arguments.next: Retire duplicated C semantic/layout decisions with matching generator/runtime/module consumers rather than add a second runtime
arguments.retirement: Retire manually synchronized emission/layout decisions after all consumers regenerate and reject stale closure

dependencies.why: Worker independence needs a complete frozen root view and park/reload protocol
Unique object authority alone does not prove frame coordinates or structural link completion
Participant withdrawal cannot discard private or descendant work
Final callbacks and resources can outlive execution admission
Frame consumers share a Scheme-owned semantic source
Native results qualify only the actual generated/header/object closure

controlSelection: Gambit full multi-shot is the semantic baseline; study Chez mixed one-shot/multi-shot stack representation and Guile delimited composition and foreign barriers; do not import OCaml one-shot, Guile thread confinement or a foreign GC policy as Gambit semantics
